nodes.prompt:
TASK: Write deterministic failing-first frontend regression tests for Ferryx's reported bug: each Git worktree must display independent tabs/sessions and app restart must preserve every registered workspace instead of clobbering saved state. This is an executable assignment.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only test files, run the literal focused commands, and report the exact RED output, test names, and root cause each failure proves. Do not change production code.
SCOPE: You may edit ONLY ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts, and ui/src/App.test.tsx. Read production code as needed. Test 1 must exercise existing public store actions against two worktrees and fail because selecting B leaves A's tabs visible (or because B cannot retain an independent tab set). Test 2 must exercise the App's actual save/restore seam so a preloaded workspace A plus active B is expected to persist as two entries and fails because auto-save/close save replaces A. Test 3 may be needed only if it adds a distinct browser-tab ownership edge. Tests must use existing mocks/helpers and fail for behavior, not TypeScript compile errors or timing luck.
VERIFY: From ui run exactly: bun test src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts src/App.test.tsx. It must fail due to the new assertions. Capture the command output in your report.
STOP WHEN: The test-only diff is complete, the focused command is RED for the intended behavioral assertions, and no production file was modified. Do not commit. Preserve all unrelated existing changes.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Add one failing-first Rust integration test proving Ferryx's native session loader must accept and preserve the real TypeScript version-2 session envelope, including multiple workspaces and optional typed v2 tab data. This is an executable assignment.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only src-tauri/tests/session_persistence_integration.rs; add a test that writes a representative version-2 JSON session payload with alpha and beta workspaces, typed terminal/browser tab fields, and per-worktree layouts, then loads it through the public loader and asserts both workspaces survive. Run it RED and report exact output. Do not modify Rust production code.
SCOPE: Read src-tauri/src/session/mod.rs and the existing integration test. Write ONLY src-tauri/tests/session_persistence_integration.rs. The test must fail because the current loader rejects version 2 or cannot decode its actual fields, not because of a malformed fixture. Do not commit.
VERIFY: From src-tauri run exactly: cargo test --test session_persistence_integration. It must fail at the new behavioral assertion.
STOP WHEN: The test-only diff is complete, the literal cargo command is RED for the intended v2 restore behavior, and no production source was modified.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement Ferryx worktree-isolated tab/session state and restart persistence to turn the existing RED frontend tests green. This is an executable assignment.
DELIVERABLE: Production changes only in ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/lib/types.ts, and ui/src/App.tsx (do not rewrite the tests except to correct an objectively invalid assertion); a report of exact modified behavior and GREEN outputs.
SCOPE: Preserve unrelated uncommitted edits exactly. Implement the selected model: (1) state.layout is the active worktree's complete layout; inactive worktree layouts are stored by path and atomically swapped on worktree selection; sessions remain project-global; (2) new terminal/browser tabs are added to the path captured at initiation, even if selection changes while async creation resolves; BrowserTab retains its worktreePath; (3) serialize all worktree layouts and only sessions they reference; deserialize old flat payloads compatibly and v3 per-worktree payloads without losing pane trees, tab groups, browser metadata, or dead-session respawn data; (4) merge the active workspace update into an existing full PersistedWorkspaceSession instead of overwriting other workspace entries; load the current session before close/autosave merge, serialized saves must not race such that a stale workspace state gets written after selection. (5) App must treat restored parked layouts as a successful restore and preserve terminal respawn behavior for all restored worktree sessions.
VERIFY: From ui run exactly: bun test src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts src/App.test.tsx; then bun run build. Both must exit 0. Run an LSP diagnostic check for every production TypeScript file modified.
STOP WHEN: All RED frontend tests are GREEN, the UI build passes, diagnostics are clean, no test is weakened/deleted/skipped, and your report names the exact evidence. Do not commit.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the smallest Rust session persistence repair that makes the added native version-2 session integration test pass without regressing version-1 compatibility. This is an executable assignment.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only src-tauri/src/session/mod.rs, preserve atomic save/load/clear behavior, and report exact GREEN output.
SCOPE: Make the persisted DTO forward-compatible with the real frontend session envelope: accept supported v1/v2/v3 versions, preserve optional per-worktree layout maps and typed terminal/browser tab fields during serde round-trip, and keep legacy v1 fixtures valid. Use typed serde fields or serde_json::Value only at the untrusted persistence boundary; do not change IPC or daemon protocol files. Do not touch unrelated existing edits and do not commit.
VERIFY: From src-tauri run exactly: cargo test --test session_persistence_integration; then cargo test session::tests. Both must exit 0.
STOP WHEN: The RED native test is GREEN with old tests still passing, no unsafe code or suppressed warnings was introduced, and the report includes exact command evidence.
